# Invensis

> > Invensis provides business process outsourcing (BPO) services specializing in finance & accounting, healthcare revenue cycle management, data entry, and technology development with OCR, ERP, and EDI integration.

Invensis delivers outsourcing solutions across accounting, medical billing, ecommerce catalog management, and custom software development. Their services emphasize HIPAA compliance, automation technologies like OCR and EDI, and integration with ERP, EMR, and EHR systems for clients in healthcare, logistics, construction, and retail sectors.

## Key Topics

- Invoice Processing & AP Automation
- Revenue Cycle Management (RCM)
- Medical Billing & Healthcare BPO
- HIPAA Compliance
- OCR (Optical Character Recognition)
- ERP & EDI Integration
- Accounts Payable & Finance Accounting
- Data Entry & Catalog Management
- EMR/EHR Systems
- CPT & ICD-10 Coding
- Ecommerce Product Listing
- Customs Clearance & Logistics
- Financial Reporting & Bookkeeping
- Claims Processing
- SEO Optimization for Product Data

## Finance & Accounting Services

- [Invoice Processing Outsourcing Services](https://www.invensis.net/services/outsource-invoice-processing): Invoice processing outsourcing with OCR/ERP integration for AP automation

- [Construction Accounting & Bookkeeping Services](https://www.invensis.net/services/construction-accounting-bookkeeping): Construction accounting with job costing, WIP tracking, and compliance
